author: Seung Wook
problem: Read two positive integers A and B. Print Hard if adding them in decimal produces a carry at any digit position, otherwise print Easy.
bug_description: The digit loop runs range(1, n) instead of range(1, n+1), so the n-th digit from the right (the leading digit of the shorter number) is never checked for a carry.

comments.accurate: Checks each digit position the two numbers share for a carry when adding A and B
comments.wrong_behavior: Checks the lower shared digit positions of A and B for a carry
comments.wrong_location: Digit loop verified; check that the digits are read from the right end of each string
